step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify application stack components drawn inside the left container: CloudFront, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, AWS Certificate Manager (ACM), and Route 53.
2. Identify Service Catalog products (Product A, Product B, Product C) in the middle column that standardize and package atomic application stack components.
3. Identify CloudFormation, which assembles selected Service Catalog products into complete project solutions.
4. Identify CodePipeline, which receives CloudFormation templates and orchestrates deployments across Dev, Test, and Prod environments.
5. Map edges showing the flow from application stack components to Service Catalog products, from Service Catalog products to CloudFormation, and from CloudFormation to CodePipeline.

graph.name: Bristol Myers Squibb - Standardized Application Stack Assembly using AWS Service Catalog
graph.notes: Bristol Myers Squibb abstracts application components (S3, CloudFront, Lambda, API Gateway, ACM, Route 53) into reusable AWS Service Catalog products. CloudFormation assembles these products into full project solutions, which CodePipeline then deploys across Dev, Test, and Production environments, reducing deployment times from weeks to 15 minutes.
